items.title: Sheaves of sets on a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens are filtered colimits of finite coequalisers of constant sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement exhibits every sheaf of sets on a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens as a filtered colimit of finite coequalisers of coproducts of sheaves supported on members of the basis with finite values (author lemma at source lines 3232-3248, label lemma-filtered-colimit-constructibles). The proof (source lines 3250-3274) first presents the sheaf as a coequaliser of two infinite coproducts, then views the target as a filtered colimit with injective transition maps and uses the compatibility of sections over quasi-compact opens with that colimit to match the indices into finite subsets, so that the sheaf becomes the colimit of the finite coequalisers (proof lines 3265-3273). The index matching through the quasi-compactness hypothesis is the content. H2.
